lines.text: You get out here. Your MI6 training starts now. And probably won’t last very long if I had to guess.
You’re not joining for the training.
The other recruits have been here for six months. I expect them to run the whole program now. Prepare yourself, you’re six months behind, so ‘welcome to a new kind of tension'.
In that case, wake me up when September ends, and I right?
Well then good morning (emphasis) because it’s December.
No it’s - but you said - nevermind.
